summary: `gyomu-workflow` is the core workflow engine for the Gyomu CLI, responsible for driving the snapshot pipeline. It coordinates request translation, validation, checkpoint tracking, target resolution, and the execution of specialized project actions such as docstrings, READMEs, packages, and LLM contexts.
responsibilities: Manage the execution of the snapshot workflow pipeline from initial request translation to final action execution.
Validate request parameters and Python package structures.
Track pipeline state and step completion via persistent checkpoints and input fingerprinting.
Resolve and filter target source files for snapshot generation.

capabilities.name: Request Validation and Translation
capabilities.description: Translates and validates user requests and structural requirements for generating project snapshots.

capabilities.name: Checkpoint and State Tracking
capabilities.description: Tracks execution progress, file changes, and step completion using checkpoints and input fingerprints.

capabilities.name: Target Resolution and Filtering
capabilities.description: Resolves snapshot targets and filters project files according to specified path patterns.

capabilities.name: Workflow Action Execution
capabilities.description: Executes modular workflow actions including docstring processing, package analysis, README generation, and LLM context creation.

design_decisions: Employs a pipelined workflow architecture with explicit checkpointing to manage long-running snapshot tasks.
Separates request validation, target resolution, and action execution into distinct processing stages.
Organizes functionality around specialized domain actions such as docstrings, packages, directories, and LLM contexts.
usage_guidance: Use the snapshot runner entry point to execute the complete workflow pipeline based on validated snapshot requests.
Leverage checkpoint mechanisms to resume or optimize pipeline execution based on file fingerprints and completed steps.
Configure snapshot actions and filters using the provided option and filter models.
